Cooperation of Bangladesh in the
investigation into Hyderabad
twin blasts
*81. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 2-day Home
Secretary level talks between India and
Bangladesh held in the month of August,
2007 agreed to take swift action on
actionable intelligence on insurgents and
fugitives to be shared between law
enforcement agencies of the two
countries;
(b) if so, whether Government has
sought the cooperation of  Bangladesh in
the investigation on the 25th August
Hyderabad twin blasts wherein
Bangladeshis have been held responsible;
(c) whether those held responsible have
been handed over to India; and
(d) the steps, Bangladesh has taken to
check the infiltration of Bangladeshis into
this country?
Joint strategy for countering threats
from various militant groups
*82. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:  Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a 3-day annual
conference of Director-Generals and
Inspector-Generals of Police, organized by
the Intelligence Bureau was held in the
month of October, 2007 to discuss a joint
strategy with police chiefs from all States,
para-military forces and security agencies
on countering threats from various militant
groups;
(b) whether top officials have sought a
policy for close monitoring of procedures
for providing security to various persons;
(c) if so, the outcome of the conference
held; and
(d) the concrete steps being taken to
meet the threat of terrorists in various
States?

Nexus between terrorist outfits and
Maoists in Nepal
†*83. SHRI SURENDRA LATH:  Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that United
Liberation Front of Asom (ULFA) camps
have been shifted from Bangladesh to
Nepal;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
terrorist outfits of  North-East have a nexus
with the Maoists of Nepal;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
Naxalites in India have a nexus with
Maoists in Nepal and they are also
imparted training from Nepal; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Committee for upgradation
of  ITIs
*84. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI MAHMOOD A.
MADANI:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has
constituted any Committee for the
upgradation of Industrial Training Institutes
(ITIs);
(b) if so, the composition and the
mandate of such Committee; and
(c) what is the level of participation of
private sector in this Committee?
Import of Chinese toys

the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the reasons of returning to China the

(b) whether it is a fact that China is
supplying those toys to India which were
returned by America;
(c) whether there exists a system to check
the quality of toys imported from China;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Misuse of arms licences
*86. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
unregulated sale of arms licences has come
under the Supreme Court's scanner which
has asked the Centre and all States to
furnish their responses on allegations that
such licences are being issued without
following proper guidelines and also on the
contentions about sale of service arms by
Army personnel to arms dealers for
monetary gains;
(b) if so, whether States and Centre have
already furnished details as required by the
Supreme  Court;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the steps being taken to check
misuse of arms licences?

DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to

RAIAH: Will the Minister of TEXTILES
be pleased to state:

approved the restructured Technology

Incursions by Chinese Army into
Indian territory
*89. MS. MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has ascertained
the facts regarding media reports quoting
the Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP) on
recurrent incursions by Chinese Army into
Indian territory in Sikkim and Arunachal
Pradesh;
(b) whether Government has taken up
the specific instances of such incursions

Government agencies have differing stands

Government agencies?
Publication of official history of wars
†*90. SHRI PYARELAL KHANDEL-
WAL: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Kargil Committee had
recommended to publish the official history
of Indo-China war of 1962, Indo-Pak wars
of 1965 and 1971 and Kargil war of 1999;
and
(b) if so, by when the said history would
be published?
Eradication of child labour
*91. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA:  Will the
Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of policy initiative
measures that have been taken or proposed
to be taken by Government to eradicate
child labour in the country;
(b) the details of efforts made so far by
Government in this respect; and
(c) the details of schemes formulated
and being implemented by Government
alongwith the funds allocated for the
purpose in this regard?

Broadcasting service through I.P.T.
*92. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
undertake broadcasting service through
Internet Protocol Television (I.P.T.) under
unified system of telecom;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether besides TV channels,
Internet TV channels are also proposed to
be provided through I.P.T.;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the manner in which it is proposed
to control the broadcasting of pornographic
contents through the I.P.T. platform?
Implementation of ARWSP
*93. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Accelerated Rural Water
Supply Programme (ARWSP) introduced
in 1972-73 assists States and Union
Territories with 100 per cent grant-in-aid
to implement drinking water supply to
problem villages;
(b) if so, the amount of grant-in-aid
provided to different States and Union
Territories till March, 2007 and number of
villages covered in each of them;
(c) the provision made for the purpose
during 2007-08 and by when all problem
villages are likely to be provided with
drinking water; and
(d) the authorities made responsible  to
ensure that the grant-in-aid provided are
utilized for the purpose and all such villages
are no more starved of drinking water?
Violation of TV norms by
broadcasters
*94. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND BROAD-
CASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several TV
broadcasters like Sony TV are telecasting
advertisements in non-empanelled serials/
programmes of Directorate of Advertising
and Visual Publicity (DAVP);
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether these broadcasters are
violating guidelines and norms of DAVP
by telecasting advertisements on non-
empanelled serials/programmes of DAVP;
and
(d) if so, the action taken against these
broadcasters and whether DAVP would
recover advertisement cost from these
channels and if not the reasons therefor?
Unregulated growth of BPOs
*95. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been unregulated
growth of Business Process Outsourcing
(BPOs) companies;
(b) if so, whether the employees are
made to work for longer hours leading to
stress;
(c) if so, whether it is proposed to
appoint a regulator for such companies;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?

shareholding

SEKHAR: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE  AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Department of
Industrial Policy and Promotion has
suggested a significant relaxation of the
definition of indirect foreign share
holding;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when a final decision in the matter
is likely to be taken?
World Bank aid for upgradation of
ITIs
*97. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the World
Bank has been providing aid for the
upgradation of Industrial Training Institutes
(ITIs);
(b) if so, the details of the scheme;
(c) whether the World Bank has given
the aid under certain terms and conditions;
(d)  if so, the details of such conditions;
(e) the ITIs identified for such
upgradation and on what basis; and
(f) the stakes of State Governments in
the upgradation of such ITIs?
Change in advertisement
policy
†*98. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is considering
broad changes in present  policy regarding
giving advertisements in newspapers;
(b) if so, the details of new proposal
regarding advertisement policy; and
(c) by when this would be implemented
in the country by Government?
Implementation of
NREG programme
*99. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has reviewed
the progress of the implementation of the
National Rural Employment Guarantee
programme;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the names of States which are lagging
behind in the implementation of National
Rural Employment Guarantee programme;
and
(d) the steps taken by Government
against these States?

Domestic Product (GDP), the number of
employment opportunities in the organised

National Authority for geographical
indicators for intellectual property
rights
291. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a National
Authority to determine geographical
indicators is necessary to secure against
possible infringement of intellectual
property right of any community or region;
(b) if so, whether it is a fact that the
country does not have such national
authority to determine geographical
indicators;
(c) if so, the reasons for delay in setting
up such national authority and what steps
are being taken to expedite the process;
and
(d) whether Government has made
transitory arrangement in this regard?
Non-availability of residues detection
facilities
292. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that imported
agricultural commodities were not subjected
for the presence of pesticides residues due
to non-availability of residues detection
facilities; and
(b) how many consignments of our
agricultural commodities have been returned
by other countries on account of presence
of unacceptable levels of pesticides residues
in the past five years and details of
commodities and countries?
Report on SEZs by MPs panel
293. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether a panel of Member of
Parliament has reportedly submitted the
Report titled "The functioning of Special
Economic Zones" on June 20, 2007;
(b) whether the panel has opined that
existing rules under SEZ Act had failed to

70
protect the farmers' interests and 'New
Special Economic Zones' should be put on
hold;
(c) if so, what are the other
recommendations made by the panel; and
(d) whether Government propose to
bring forward draft legislation to amend the
Act during the ensuing Winter Session of
Parliament?
Abnormal increase in cement price
294. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been an abnormal
increase in cement price especially in some
States;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the action taken to regulate the price
of cement?
High heavy metal content in herbs
exported
295. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian herbal
exports often face rejection on grounds of
high heavy metal content and the presence
of other unwanted ingredients; and
(b) if so, the details of action taken by
Government to prevent such rejection due
to high heavy metal content?
Trade with Gulf, Western Asian and
African countries
†296. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: W ill the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the extent of trade carried out by the
country with the Gulf, West Asian and
African countries;
(b) whether Government propose to
hold talks with Gulf Co-operation Council
on Free Trade Agreement and with West
Asian and African countries on Investment
Promotion Agreements; and
(c) if so, the details of the benefits
derived as a result of these agreements?
Setting up of Leather Industry Parks
†297. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have proposed
setting up of five leather industry parks in
the country;
(b) if so, the name of the cities where
these Leather Industry Parks will be set
up;
(c) what schemes have been formulated
by Government for providing employment
to maximum people in these parks; and
(d) what is the maximum number of
persons likely to get employment in these
parks and what steps have been taken by
Government for simplification of export
of leather products?
Plethora of regulations for foreign
entrepreneurs
298. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the World Bank's recent report mentioning
about existence of plethora of Government
regulations that foreign entrepreneurs have
to cope with while doing business in India;

undertaken in this regard will fructify as
we are even much behind the pace of such
reforms done in China; and
(c) will time-bound reforms be done so
that in foreseeable future, the tedious red-
tape no longer adversely affects our
business scenario?
EOUs in the country
299. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: W ill the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of State-wise Export-
Oriented Industrial Units (EOUs) working
in the country as on date;
(b) the number of proposals received to
establish export-oriented units during last

of proposals sanctioned; and

basic and other facilities to start
production?
Import of toys from China
300. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether import of toys from China
have increased manifold during the last two
years;
(b) if so, what is the estimated value of
toys imported during the last two years;
(c) whether large scale Chinese made
toys are found to be very harmful for
children; and
(d) if so, the details of such toys and
action taken by Government to stop the
import of harmful toys from China?
Shifting of Spices Park from Andhra
Pradesh
301. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:

has decided to set up Spices Park in Andhra
Pradesh; and
(b) if so, what are the reasons behind
Government's plan to shift it from Andhra
Pradesh to some other State when the State
is ready to provide land and other
infrastructure which the Spice Board
required?
Ban on import of prawns by Australia
302. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Australia has
announced banning import of prawns from
India which hit largely Andhra Pradesh since
it is the largest producer of prawns in the
country;
(b) if so, the reasons for such a ban;
(c) what is the quantity of seafood
exported to Australia from India; and
(d) how MPEDA is planning to help
the seafood growers in the State of Andhra
Pradesh in the light of this ban?
Acquisition of farmers land by State
303. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
several State Governments have acquired
farmers land and have provided it to private
companies for commercial activities;
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last two years, State-wise;

72
(c) whether Government propose to
frame any regulation for limiting the
acquisition of land by State Government/
Industry so that it does not reduce
agriculture land; and
(d) if  so, the details thereof?
Regulation for mercury consumption
304. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has formulated
any policy to regulate the consumption of
mercury for non-industrial purposes, since
India is the second largest consumer of
mercury in the world importing 200 tonnes
every year;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Low exports of herbal medicines
305. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that our country's
share in the global exports of herbal
medicines is low;
(b) if so, whether Government have
analyzed the reasons for this low
production of herbal medicines; and
(c) the details of action taken by
Government to increase production and
export of herbal medicines?
Sponsor of journalists by MoD
†306. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether visits of journalists are
sponsored by the Ministry of Defence;
and
(b) if so, the number of journalist from
print media as well as electronic media sent
for these visits?
Manufacture of cabins of Stallion and
LPTA vehicles
307. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE:
SHRI MOHAMMED AMIN:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether one hydraulic press was
commissioned in May, 2003 for in-house
manufacture of cabins of Stallion and LPTA
transport vehicles in Vehicle Factory,
Jabalpur;
(b) if so, the cost of the same;
(c) whether the same was not used and
requirement of cabin was met through
outsourcing which cost more than Rs. 100
crore till March, 2005; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Review of Offset Clause in Defence
Procurement Procedure 2006
308. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
proposes to review the Offset Clause under
the Defence Procurement Procedure 2006;
(b) if so, the details of the reasons
warranting such a review; and
(c) whether it is a fact that the vendors
have expressed reservations to the Offset
Clause?

problems

SHRI SATYAVRAT

pleased to state:

Development Organisation has given any
suggestions for resolving of the problems
confronting the soldiers such as depression,
difficult working conditions owing to the
proxy war;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of units where these
reforms have been implemented;
(d) whether the same would be
implemented in other units after studying
their result; and
(e) by when these reforms would be
implemented in all the units?
Joint marketing strategy for export of
BrahMos
310. SHRI MANOHAR JOSHI: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the Indo-Russian joint venture that makes
BrahMos is still awaiting an inter-
governmental agreement that will allow it
to market the weapon system globally;
(b) whether Government of India and
Russia are yet to formulate a joint marketing
strategy for the sale of the BrahMos
system to other countries; and
(c) if so, by what time joint marketing
strategy is going to be formulated for the
export of this Supersonic Missile?
Shortage of soldiers
†311. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there is an acute shortage of
soldiers and army men in the army;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the urgent steps being taken by
Government to enhance recruitment in the
army for the safety of the country; and
(d) the outcome of the measures taken
by Government?
Compulsory NCC training

Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to impart NCC training to every
student compulsorily at Higher Secondary

patriotism;
(b) if so, the details of the scheme and
proposal;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the reaction of Government thereto?

SSO and regular officers

"Ajay Vikram Singh Committee" laying
down that 1,100 Short Service Officers and

followed; and
(c) if not, what are the reasons for not
implementing this recommendation?

awardee families

country are at present pending in his
Ministry;
(b) the nature of grievances and the
action taken/proposed to be taken thereon;
and
(c) by when all these representations
are likely to be disposed of?

Punjab

SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have received representations from several
ex-servicemen from the State of Punjab

employment to their family member etc.;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what steps Government has taken

Exemption of three Service Chiefs

airports

(a) whether his Ministry has taken up
with the Ministry of Civil Aviation that
three Service Chiefs be exempted from
security procedures at civil airports in line

and senior bureaucrats; and
(b) if so, the reaction of the Ministry of
Civil Aviation thereto?

SHRI PRASANTA

2006 and 15th December, 2004

(a) the status of finalizing the proposal

(b) whether Government is aware of
the significance of such academy in
